prompt_serialization: frozen system prompt, two LF bytes, exact materialized context
session_isolation: --ephemeral; one fresh Codex invocation and one fresh full pinned worktree per run

worktree_architecture.checkout: shallow pinned source cache checkout with complete tree

status_capture: git status --porcelain=v1 before and after the model run
test_discovery: TESTS_EXECUTED, NO_TESTS_RAN, and TEST_EXECUTION_STATUS are recorded separately

network.coding_agent_provider: inherits the normal host shell network environment
network.provider_precheck: DNS and TCP reachability to chatgpt.com:443 before preflight and before every statistical batch
network.dependency_setup: pinned source and dependency caches are prepared before the model call and task dependency network is disabled
network.excluded_preflight_cache: host-enabled go mod download followed by the exact frozen test command with GOPROXY=off; model call is blocked unless offline tests execute and pass

storage.codex_home: inherited from the normal host shell; not overridden by default
storage.codex_home_isolation_opt_in: --isolate-codex-home uses disposable per-slot metadata only when explicitly requested
storage.git_safe_directory: environment-scoped safe.directory=* for disposable V4 worktrees
storage.cleanup: remove the complete slot and slot temporary directory in finally after capture, grading, and test verification

retry_policy: retry only objective infrastructure failures with no usable model output; never retry a usable coding result
statistical_design: 7 tasks x 3 arms x 3 repetitions = 63 fresh V4 Codex runs
